headline: Housing board adjourns early over Sunshine Law concern

meeting.summary: Housing board adjourns early over Sunshine Law concern.
meeting.recap: The chair called the meeting to order at 9:08 a.m.[[0:00:33]] A resident asked the board to put into effect Bill 111, a 2021 bill not yet enacted.[[0:02:23]] She said the bill creates a county list of people who want affordable housing.[[0:03:13]] She said a lottery would give priority to people who have lived on Maui the longest.[[0:03:42]] The board approved corrected minutes from its February 19, 2026 meeting.[[0:05:50]] The housing department presented a chart of proposed changes to chapter 2.96, the county's residential workforce housing law.[[0:09:47]] The department said other parts of county code wrongly point to chapter 2.96 for fee waiver rules.[[0:12:26]] The department proposed defining area median income, a term used throughout chapter 2.96 but not defined.[[0:14:48]] A county lawyer said a problem with the agenda's meeting link might violate the Sunshine Law, a public meeting law.[[0:17:11]] The lawyer said the safest option was to move the items to a future meeting.[[0:18:35]] The lawyer said discussing items without voting would not change that.[[0:19:41]] The chair adjourned the meeting and said all items will be reposted.[[0:21:43]] Staff confirmed the next meeting is June 26.[[0:22:26]]
decided: The chair adjourned the meeting so the items can be reposted for another time.
meeting.next: All items discussed at this meeting will be reposted for another time. The chair said reposting gives the public more time to review the items and prepare testimony.

moments.q: Public testimony on Bill 111 and applicant selection
